          expose: [],
          methods: {
            foo() {},
            bar() {},
          }
        }
      </script>

<script>
        export default {
          setup(_, {expose}) {
            expose({
              foo() {}
            })
            return {
              bar() {}
            }
          }
        }
      </script>

        export default {
          setup(_, {expose}) {
            expose()

              foo() {},
              bar() {}
            }
          }
        }
      </script>

          setup(_, ctx) {

            return {
              bar() {}
            }
          }
        }
      </script>
